# telnyx_messaging_tollfree_verification_requests (Data Source)

Lists messaging tollfree verification requests, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_messaging_tollfree_verification_request`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `business_name` (String)
- `date_end` (String)
- `date_start` (String)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `phone_number` (String)
- `status` (String) Tollfree verification status One of `In Progress`, `Rejected`, `Verified`, `Waiting For Customer`, `Waiting For Telnyx`, `Waiting For Vendor`.

### Read-Only

- `messaging_tollfree_verification_requests` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--messaging_tollfree_verification_requests))
